rules: Older-model decoded live proposals 8..125 frames, fast-head mean support >=0.65, at least 3 close-control supported frames, enclosed by opposite current ownership. Replace team emissions only within those automatically predicted proposals. Keep current D except bounded contact/moving-ball attenuation. No true short-run interval endpoints enter inference.
promotion: All paired stitched spellF1 deltas >=0; all paired D recalls >=reference-0.02; no extra mostly missed stoppages. For every buffered seed: strictly fewer false-D frames and higher short-live mean recall. Allow at most .005 MacroF1 loss per pair. Report every block regression. Prefer more false-D reduction among eligible finalists; keep seed42 fixed.
interpretation: Adaptive follow-up to 595 existing score rows and the current refinement screen. Confirmation reuses the same 17 public possessions; it is not independent or selection-adjusted evidence. No new settings may be tuned to these seed checks.
